parents.subject: Molecular and Cell Biology
parents.course: Special Topics in Cell and Developmental Biology

ns2:section.sectionText: Although microbes are essential to every ecosystem less than 1% of the diversity of microbes from the natural world are in culture in the lab. This laboratory-based course will teach students how to design culturing strategies to target and grow microbes from natural systems. We focus as an example on microbes associated with plants (clover) and animals (bees) from the long-term ecological research site called the Kellogg Biological Research station LTER.
